# ============================================================
#  config_watchlist.txt — Watched Configuration Scopes
# ============================================================
# Mod users run an updater that skips the config folder so personal MTL preferences
# are not overwritten. When any key inside a watched scope is added, removed, or
# changed, a warning banner is shown in GitHub Releases and Discord.
#
# Syntax (no regex):
#   [Section]          -> watches EVERY key inside [Section] (case-insensitive)
#   [Section] KeyName  -> watches a specific literal key in [Section] (case-insensitive)
#
# Note: Section-level entries intentionally fire on preference keys too; that is
# the user's explicit choice. Secret values (ApiKey, Token, Secret, Password)
# and C:\Users\<name> paths are automatically redacted before output.

[Texture]
